name: Energy Shield
text: Shields block damage and prevent new negative status effects (Fire, Freezing, A.C.I.D, etc.). Only direct damage will remove the Shield.

name: Fire Immunity
text: This unit cannot be set on Fire.

name: Flying
text: Flying units can be positioned at any terrain tile, except mountains and other units. Mountains and unfriendly units can be overflown. Flying mechs cannot be waterlogged, and all flying units are not affected by lava or A.C.I.D. tiles, because they don't submerge. Flying units are not immune to A.C.I.D. pools, fire, or emerging Vek.

name: Natural Armor
text: Weapon damage to this unit is reduced by 1, including Psionic Tyrant's Hive Targeted ability. All other damage (Push, Blocking, Fire, etc.) is unaffected.

name: Smoke Immunity
text: This unit is unaffected by Smoke. Note that an enemy unit with this special ability will still be damaged by electric smoke (for e.g., the ACID Storm Controller).

name: A.C.I.D.
text: Weapon damage against this unit is doubled and Natural Armor is disabled. All other damage (Push, Blocking, Fire, etc.) is unaffected. Repairing removes the effect.

name: Boost
text: This unit's damage is increased by 1 on its next attack. Affects all targets of the attack, including self damage. Removed upon any ability use, including non-damaging abilities and repairing; repairing while Boosted will heal 2 points.

name: Fire
text: Units on Fire take 1 damage at the start of every turn. Repairing removes the effect, so does ending a movement Submerged in Water or in Smoke. Flying units cannot submerge in Water.

name: Frozen
text: Units that are frozen are unable to move or attack, but can free themselves by repairing. Any damage to a frozen unit is negated, but will free the unit.

name: Webbed
text: Units webbed by the Vek cannot move, but they can still attack.

name: Smoke
text: Units in Smoke cannot attack or repair.

name: Submerged
text: Weapons do not work when submerged in Water.

name: Alpha Unit
text: Alpha units are more powerful than their standard counterparts

name: Burrower
text: This Vek will hide underground after taking one or more damage.

name: Explosive Decay
text: Explodes on death, dealing 1 damage to adjacent tiles. This damage ignores Armor!

name: Hardened Carapace
text: The Shell Psion is providing Armor to all Vek, reducing incoming weapon damage by 1. All other damage (Push, Blocking, Fire, etc.) is unaffected.

name: Hive Leader
text: These are the most powerful Vek. Immune to water, they can be more challenging to kill.

name: Hive Targeted
text: The Psion Tyrant will do 1 damage all friendly units every turn.

name: Invigorating Spores
text: The Soldier Psion is providing +1 HP to all Vek.

name: Massive
text: Massive units can walk in Water (but Water will prevent shooting).

name: Overpowered
text: The Psion Abomination is enhancing all Vek. They gain +1 HP, regeneration, and explode on death.

name: Regeneration
text: The Blood Psion is healing all Vek 1 point every turn.

name: Self-Repairing
text: If damaged, this unit will Shield itself and prepare to heal.

name: Stable
text: Cannot be moved by any weapon effect (Push, Teleport, etc.).

name: Spawner
text: Spawns two Medium Goos on death.

name: Minor
text: This unit does not grant XP to pilots on kill.

name: Mine Immunity
text: This unit avoids mines.
